conventions.bbox: [x0, y0, x1, y1], fractions of the PDF page (A4, incl. the white frame around the scan)

drawings.description: une boucle et quelques points, avec des flèches à double pointe partant d'un sommet, étiquetées $x$ et $xg$ ; au-dessous « Diagramme de Cayley » et un encadré « $g$, $g'$, $gh$ » ; une seconde boucle et deux flèches horizontales vers la gauche.
drawings.kind: Cayley diagram sketch: loop, points, double-headed arrows
drawings.notes: The lower half of p. 36 is written upside down; crop rotated 180 degrees. A boxed "g, g', gh" and two horizontal arrows (pointing left on the page as it lies, right once turned), "Diagramme de Cayley"; a loop from a vertex with two double-headed arrows labelled x and xg, a row of points, and a second loop on the right ending at g. The box contents read like g, g_1, ..., g_k on the crop; the transcription's g, g', gh are kept. Two long oblique strokes crossing the region are drawn grey. The upside-down sentence at the bottom ("Mettre les g_i ... origine") is text.
drawings.orientation: upside down on the page (tete-beche half); crop rotated 180 degrees, redraw upright, coordinates in the rotated crop

drawings.description: dans la marge gauche, un quadrant d'axes avec des points disposés en escalier sous la diagonale, figurant les bidegrés $(i,j)$, $j \le i$, où le morphisme est un isomorphisme.
drawings.kind: quadrant with staircase of points below the diagonal
drawings.notes: In the left margin: two axes from a small open origin, and heavy points in a staircase below the diagonal (bidegrees (i, j), j <= i), columns of 2, 3, 4 and 5 points; some points heavier than others.

drawings.description: à gauche, un schéma à traits sans flèches\,: $k$ relié par $u$, $u'$, $u''$ à $\Phi$, $\Phi'$ (écrit deux fois, un tracé biffé), $\Phi''$\,; $\Phi,\Phi'$ vers $N$, $\Phi',\Phi''$ vers $N'$, puis $N$ et $N'$ vers $N''$
drawings.notes: k joined by u, u', u'' to Phi, Phi' (written twice, one stroke struck, drawn grey), Phi''; Phi and the first Phi' to N, the second Phi' and Phi'' to N'; N and N' to N''. The small u labels are tiny and placed by eye.

drawings.description: petit croquis d'un triangle (ou tétraèdre) traversé de segments
drawings.kind: small triangle (or tetrahedron) crossed by segments
drawings.notes: Four points joined like a tetrahedron seen from the side: two triangles A-D-C and A-B-C sharing the doubled edge A-C, and a segment from D to B crossing it; a short stroke beyond D.

drawings.description: un disque hachuré marqué d'un point $\tilde x$, dans un carré, avec une boucle qui en sort
drawings.kind: hatched disc with point x~ in a square, with a loop
drawings.notes: A hatched disc with a heavy rim, the point x~ in it (and two small dots), inside a roughly drawn square; a loop leaves the disc to the right and goes out of the square.

drawings.kind: square of arrows between C^*_*, C^*_bullet, C^bullet_bullet, C^bullet_*
drawings.notes: Four nodes in a diamond: C^*_* (top), C^*_bullet (left), C^bullet_bullet (bottom), C^bullet_* = Lambda^{bullet+1} Phi_* (right), with arrows: top to left (heavy), left to bottom, bottom to right, and a double-headed arrow right - top. The braces of formulas beside the nodes are text.
drawings.disagreement: The transcription calls 17-2 and 17-3 "hexagones": on the page each is a diamond of four nodes and four arrows.

drawings.notes: The dual diamond: C_*^* = C^{*vee}_* (top), C_*^bullet = C^{bullet vee}_* (left), C_bullet^bullet = C^{bullet vee}_bullet (bottom), and on the right C^*_bullet = C^vee_{bullet *} (as read); arrows top to left, right to top, right to bottom, and left to bottom (heavy). Node labels as read on the crop (the transcription does not spell them).

drawings.description: sous deux crochets illisibles, un faisceau de segments reliant deux colonnes de points : l’image d’un shuffle.
drawings.kind: shuffle: segments between two columns of points
drawings.notes: A bundle of segments joining a left column of points to a right column: the upper ones descend steeply (crossing), the lower ones are nearly horizontal. The two bracketed labels above are struck/illegible and left out. Endpoints are approximate.

drawings.description: une petite sphère hachurée, cerclée d’un équateur épais.
drawings.kind: small hatched sphere with thick equator
drawings.notes: A small sphere, hatched, girdled by a thick equator.

drawings.description: à droite, un petit diagramme du plan $(i,j)$ : la ligne $j=n$ porte des $0$, et la région au-dessus est hachurée.
drawings.kind: small diagram of the (i, j) plane with hatched region
drawings.notes: Axes (horizontal with an arrow), the line j = n (labelled n on the left), oblique hatching strokes above it, and two 0s just below the line.
